name: museum-of-my-mind
description: A quiet, local-first museum for your mind: goals become stars, projects become planets, and unsorted thoughts drift as dust in a living 3D sky. Offline PWA, no account, end-to-end-encrypted sync.

paragraphs: A quiet, private place to see your thoughts, sort them, and find your way when life feels crowded.
Your goals become stars, your projects become planets, and the thoughts you have not dealt with yet drift between them like dust, until you are ready.
Every screenshot in this README shows Alex, a made-up person whose example museum ships with the app. No real person's data appears anywhere.
features: Each area of your life is a galaxy: health, a side project, creativity, the people you love, or anything else you choose.

A goal is a star. It is a direction you could follow for years, with one line about why it matters to you. The more recently a goal has moved, the brighter its star burns. One you have not touched in weeks fades gently.…
Projects are planets that orbit their goal. Each one has a ring of light that closes as it progresses.
Unsorted thoughts drift as soft dust inside their galaxy, or between galaxies if they do not belong anywhere yet. Nothing is lost there, and nothing nags.
The journal keeps what happened and how it felt, in your own words, apart from your goals. Months later, On this day brings it back.

whatItDoes.text: A quiet, private place to see your thoughts, sort them, and find your way when life feels crowded.

requirements.text: Open the museum → · no account · nothing to install · works offline · your data never leaves your device unless you choose
Your data stays on your device, with no account, no telemetry, no analytics, no third-party scripts and no hosted database of readable data.
